title: Raster Picnic
message:
Raster Picnic: an invitation screen for a tiny computer-club gathering.
D major, 126 BPM, A / A' / B / A'', four channels for Paula.
All samples synthesized (sound library presets). Source: songs/raster_picnic.gen.js;
MOD via tools/json2mod.js. Rendered and checked, not yet listened to.
